Microsoft launches fourth cloud region in Hyderabad, India

Microsoft has launched its fourth cloud region in India, located in Hyderabad. This expansion increases Microsoft's data center footprint in the country to four regions. The new facility is intended to support India's artificial intelligence economy and strengthen enterprise adoption of cloud services. Global real estate firm Knight Frank reported that Mumbai ranks 15th and Hyderabad ranks 27th globally in operational data centre capacity.
